items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The front line was Wardell Gray, Willie Smith, Roy Eldridge, and myself.

ctx.x: Yeah. I never forgot that. The front line was Wardell Gray, Willie Smith, Roy Eldridge, and myself. And the rhythm was Kennie Cursey on Piano, Jackie Mills on drums, and Charlie Drayton on the bass. And the singer was Anita O'Day.
